_comment: Out-of-memory check commands (H-106, design D37-LIMITS-1). The shipped default reads the container runtime's own record of one container. {container} becomes the exact container ID. jq is a filter on the command's output that must give true to confirm the stop. A user may add an entry under limits.oom_check.list.<label> in the user config; a project config may only select a label with limits.oom_check.label (D37-FLOW-8).

default.jq: if type == "array" and length == 1 then (.[0].State.OOMKilled == true) else "unclear" end
